description: This file contains the implementation of the BrentSolver class, which utilizes Brent's method for finding zeros of real univariate functions. The class extends an abstract solver and provides multiple constructors to configure the solver's accuracy parameters, as well as a core method for executing the Brent algorithm.

classes.name: BrentSolver
classes.description: A class implementing Brent's root finding algorithm for univariate functions, providing methods to initialize solver parameters and execute the solution process.

methods.name: doSolve
methods.description: Executes the Brent root-finding algorithm within the specified interval, handling various cases such as initial guesses, bracketing, and convergence criteria.

methods.name: brent
methods.description: Implements Brent's method for finding a zero of the function within a bracketing interval, employing inverse quadratic and linear interpolation, bisection, and convergence checks.
